info.title: Plantasaurus
info.description:
Track the plants in your house and garden.

Authenticate with a session cookie (`/api/v1/auth/login`) or an API token (`Authorization: Bearer pts_…`, created under `/api/v1/tokens`).

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is needed, and who is logged in

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

get.summary: List your API tokens (admins see all)

schema.title: Response List Tokens Api V1 Tokens Get

post.summary: Create an API token for integrations

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Plants Categories Get

delete.summary: Delete a plant (only if it has no instances)

schema.title: Response Plant Instances Api V1 Plants  Plant Id  Instances Get

put.summary: Save Open Plantbook API credentials. They are tested first and only saved if accepted.

schema.title: Response Opb Search Api V1 Openplantbook Search Get

post.summary: Re-fetch care ranges from Open Plantbook (names and notes are kept)

schema.title: Response List Areas Api V1 Areas Get

delete.summary: Delete an area and its spots. Refused if any plant currently lives there, or if history exists (unless force=true).

schema.title: Response Area Spots Api V1 Areas  Area Id  Spots Get
Response List Spots Api V1 Spots Get

delete.summary: Delete a spot. Refused if occupied, or if it has history (archive it instead, or force=true).

schema.title: Response Spot Positions Api V1 Spots  Spot Id  Positions Get
Response List Positions Api V1 Positions Get

get.summary: Full Area → Spot → Position tree with occupants

schema.title: Response Location Tree Api V1 Locations Tree Get

post.summary: Add a plant instance, optionally placing it (records an 'acquired' or 'planted' event)

patch.summary: Edit descriptive fields. Use the action endpoints to move, retire etc.

delete.summary: Permanently delete an instance and its history. Prefer /retire to keep the record.

post.summary: Move into new ground or a new container (records pot size / soil)
Record a death, removal or give-away, with an optional final assessment
Create a new instance from a cutting/division/seed of this one. Returns the new instance.
Record how well the plant is doing

schema.title: Response Instance Placements Api V1 Instances  Instance Id  Placements Get

get.summary: Events (newest first) with their assessments and photos

schema.title: Response Instance Timeline Api V1 Instances  Instance Id  Timeline Get

post.summary: Log a care/growth/note event (watered, fed, pruned, pest_disease, treated, flowered, fruited, harvested, photo, note)

patch.summary: Edit an event. Lifecycle events only allow notes to change, to keep history consistent.

delete.summary: Delete a care/note event. Lifecycle events cannot be deleted (history is append-only).

schema.title: Response List Fields Api V1 Custom Fields Get

delete.summary: Delete a field definition (existing values are kept but hidden)

put.summary: Save the HA connection. It is tested first and only saved if HA answers.

post.summary: Re-read devices from HA now and re-check assigned ones

get.summary: HA devices carrying the irrigation-zone or plant-monitor label, for assigning to spots

Response Health Api V1 Health Get
